column3: title card: Part II, friendly operations; lens is opt-in, off = legacy twin (ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §15-16)
column5: F: Manufacturing, part two: friendly operations. | M: An optional lens on the twin. Switched off, every screen stays as in iDempiere. Switched on, the same work takes fewer steps, and the books come out the same.

column4: M: The lens is a plugin.
column5: M: The lens is a plugin like any other. | F: We install it from the Plugins panel. It starts at once and registers one thing: the lens.

column3: card: gestures Odoo 8 (mo_produceall_woodpanel log) · twin 21 · lens 18 (ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §14.1, §15.1)
column5: F: We counted the steps for one manufacturing order, from an empty form to finished goods. | M: Odoo seventeen needs eight. The twin's plain screens need twenty-one. With the lens, eighteen. | F: Most of what remains is the order header, where the twin follows legacy defaults.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT preview.ok.panel: Manufacturing Order BOM 1 new · BOM Line 2 new · Material Requirement Planning 3 new · §SAVE-PREVIEW ok=Y ops=10 (nothing committed) · pp_order=18 unchanged
column5: M: A new order. In legacy, its components appear only after Save. | F: Preview runs the very same save, and keeps nothing. | M: One order BOM, two component lines, three planning rows. And still no new order in the database.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT preview.refused.panel: BOMExpired PP_Product_BOM 50005 not valid at 2007-01-01 (from 2007-09-22)
column5: F: Now a start date before the bill of materials is valid. | M: Preview shows the refusal Save would give: the BOM is not valid before twenty-second September two thousand seven. | F: Nothing was written. We put the date back.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lens.saveComplete documentno=80000 docstatus=CO · §OPS-LENS docAction=CO from=DR to=CO
column5: M: Save and Complete is one click. | F: It saves, then completes, through the same two steps as the toolbar and the action bar. Order eighty thousand is complete.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT form.preset=80000 · form.message=3 cost collector(s) completed: Issue 7000, Issue 100, Receipt 100 · commit ops=121 verifyChain=ok
column5: F: The order now offers its own Receipt and Issue, with the order already chosen. | M: One Process: two component issues and the receipt of one hundred units, completed in one transaction.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lens.related Cost Collector (3) tipCollectors=3 · collectors.grid=3 rows
column5: M: Back on the order, the lens shows what is linked to it, with a count. | F: Cost Collector, three. One click lists exactly those three documents.

column3: card: W-FRIENDLY-OPS read from its log: F2 events equal, F3 events equal, F6 preview rows == save rows, F7 nothing written, F9 refusal == Save
column5: F: Fewer clicks must not mean a different result. | M: A witness ran each lens action next to the plain one. Save and Complete fired the same one hundred twenty-nine model events, in the same order. The Receipt and Issue, the same ninety-nine. | F: Preview showed the ten rows Save then wrote, and wrote nothing itself.

column5: M: Stop the lens, and the same order is back on the plain iDempiere toolbar. | F: The documents stay. Only the shortcuts are gone.
